items.title: Does Amphenol (APH) Gain An Edge In AI Infrastructure From This New Partnership?

The agreement gives Rep Com International responsibility for distributing Charles Industries products across its U.S. sales network. The collaboration focuses on expanding access to Charles Industries outside plant, enclosure, and related solutions for communications and AI data infrastructure projects. items.title: APH Q3 deep dive: AI demand and acquisitions drive exceptional growth and outlook
items.summary: Electrical connector manufacturer Amphenol (NYSE:APH) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 65.1% year on year to $10.23 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($10.4 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.80 per share was 9.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
